test_title: PYST 49: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, B, C, D, T, U, V and W, are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only three people sit between C and W. D sits to the immediate left of W. No one sits to the right of B. Only two people sit between B and D. T sits to the immediate right of V. How many people sit between U and T?
solution:
Given: Seven friends B, C, D, T, U, V and W are sitting in a straight line facing north.

No one sits to the right of B.

Only two people sit between B and D.

D sits to the immediate left of W.

Only three people sit between C and W.

T sits to the immediate right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66eeedb1a320e41b82a664098a9076510339b67f713a76cd2832c845bc1e1f02.png] 

So, there are 2 people between U and T.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
